added_public_metadata_scope.before_native_intervals: Single eight-file admission occurs inside the original deadline before parent authentication observers are entered.
added_public_metadata_scope.failed_termination: Original main resource/rejected exceptions retain their existing native/status path. No completed eight-file after check is inferred if exception preempts the finish gate; outer input-preservation remains a separate driver obligation.
added_public_metadata_scope.inside_native_intervals: Registered history schema/key gates are ordinary metadata operations. Their require/canonical/sha calls use the unchanged existing native operation observer, with no new timing family.
added_public_metadata_scope.successful_termination: finish_current_count_registry also checks the eight files before successful main stdout; the two original finish_inputs wrappers include this same check.

authentication.commission_scope: The additional 2275 parent_timing_complete commission was withdrawn by 2280. This optional adjacent family supplies actual inclusive and bounded-byte context for the operation family; it is not claimed as the replacement four-operation measurement by itself.
authentication.count_types: All counts/bytes ordinary nonnegative int; elements_known ordinary bool; whole_envelope_bytes=null because this observer does not read the full envelope. The counts object is null on observer initialization failure.
authentication.elements: Actual sum of ordered_reductions list lengths observed after successful read_json for the role-root output/candidates/[0-9]{6}/reduction/reduction.json. Reused objects are not counted as a new parse; null if the list length cannot be established. It does not replace the existing full typechecked-elements event.
authentication.failure: status COMPLETED/FAILED/OBSERVER_ERROR; original BaseException is re-raised unchanged. Incomplete prefix retains observed counts and nullable unknowns. Observer exceptions or missing stderr records remain diagnostic and cannot change authentication/selection/rank/ancestry.
authentication.file_bytes: Actual successful raw bytes read by read_json for this role root during this authenticate interval, plus actual retained reused_parent_reduction second raw reads. Counts every such read, including parser-failing raw inputs. This deliberately declared scope is not all filesystem IO or full accepted-parent envelope bytes.
authentication.interval: Immediately before reader(admission) invokes the actual authenticate_* body until its return or original exception, before auxiliary telemetry emission. The one new wrapper is called from the existing ordered/parser wrappers so their old intervals and real observations remain available. Inclusive duration includes nested metadata/pin work and observer bookkeeping; never sum nested inclusive intervals.

nullable_selection.counts: null only when the counter observer could not be initialized or no event could be built; missing event stays missing.
nullable_selection.elements: observer.elements only if observer exists, final observation_error is null and counts.elements_known is true; otherwise null.
nullable_selection.file_bytes: json_raw_bytes + recheck_raw_bytes only if counts exists and final observation_error is null; otherwise null.
nullable_selection.no_reduction_read: elements is the actual empty sum 0 if the observer initialized and no matching reduction list was successfully read. It does not assert any target rows were read.
nullable_selection.seconds: finished-started if both monotonic observations exist, even for a partial failed reader; otherwise null.

observed_prefix_algebra.condition: Counter observer has no error, and each recorded call has a classified terminal hook. Never demand these identities from an incomplete or observer-error prefix.
observed_prefix_algebra.recheck: recheck_read_calls and recheck_read_failures are a separate raw comparison channel, never parse calls.
observed_prefix_algebra.successful_bytes_only: unique_json_parsed_bytes + repeated_json_parse_bytes counts only raw bytes whose read_json returned after its optional normal seal and current-key check. It need not equal all json_raw_bytes on a parser-failing input.

authentication.retention: Old exact12 ordinary parent timings, P exact25/13/14 event families, parser15 statistics, raw stderr and actual nullable/error records remain. Driver aggregates this new adjacent family and joins existing scope without claiming artifact timing was previously absent.
authentication.seconds: actual monotonic finished-started; finite nonnegative number excluding bool, or null if the observer cannot establish the interval

status_selection.COMPLETED: Original reader returned, and observation_error is null. This is completion of this declared observation, not a mathematical PASS.
status_selection.FAILED: Original reader raised BaseException; failure_type is its actual class name. This takes priority even if observation_error is also present.
status_selection.OBSERVER_ERROR: Original reader returned, and observation_error is nonnull.

types.failure_type: string or null; actual observation availability
types.finished_utc: string or null; actual observation availability
types.monotonic_finished_seconds: finite nonnegative number excluding bool, or null
types.monotonic_started_seconds: finite nonnegative number excluding bool, or null
types.observation_error: string or null; actual observation availability
types.ordinal: ordinary integer 0..7 paired to role index
types.seconds: finite nonnegative number excluding bool, or null
types.started_utc: string or null; actual observation availability

authentication.unique_and_repeat: Unique JSON document bytes count the first successfully returned parse per actual (role-root, relative name); later successfully returned parse bytes go to repeated_json_parse_bytes. Raw preparse failures contribute to json_raw_bytes but not successful parsed-byte totals. Second reduction raw comparisons are separate recheck bytes, never parser attempts.

current_telemetry_helper_raw_preservatio.exception: One F8 historical_full_file_contract call after original parse; all original observer/reader/seal lines preserved in order.
current_telemetry_helper_raw_preservatio.name: read_json

BaseException_isolation.context: Document setup and finally restoration are separately isolated from json_bytes(raw), which is invoked exactly once.
BaseException_isolation.missing: An event serialization/logger failure may leave the entire event absent. No replacement completed event is fabricated.
BaseException_isolation.native_operation_call: Exactly one original(*args, **kwargs). Its original BaseException is re-raised bare. Entry/exit observer failures and even observer error-reporting failures are caught as BaseException.
BaseException_isolation.reader: Exactly one reader(admission). Its BaseException is re-raised bare; nested finally restores both observers before logging, and the outer finally also covers setup through all postprocessing.
BaseException_isolation.scope: Only new observation setup/update/context/clock/finish/logger boundaries; old retained observers and mathematical predicates are not blanket-edited.

exact_event_selection.completion_limit: MEASURED_OPERATION_WINDOWS_COMPLETE certifies closure of these selected observed windows only. It does not assert that all native-metadata mechanisms were classified.
exact_event_selection.coverage: OBSERVER_ERROR if observation_error is nonnull, including a FAILED reader with observer error; otherwise PARTIAL_NATIVE_INTERVAL if reader failed; otherwise MEASURED_OPERATION_WINDOWS_COMPLETE.
exact_event_selection.inclusive_seconds: finished-started when both outer monotonic observations exist, otherwise null. Includes reader and observation bookkeeping, excludes subsequent event serialization.
exact_event_selection.observation_error: Actual observer.error takes precedence over setup/finish error text when present. This field remains separate from original failure_type.
exact_event_selection.status: FAILED if original reader failed; otherwise OBSERVER_ERROR if final observation_error is nonnull; otherwise COMPLETED.
exact_event_selection.unattributed_seconds: Only for successful reader, no observer error, available inclusive interval and initialized operation rows: inclusive_seconds minus the sum of nonnull exclusive seconds of all four operations and three exclusions. Nonfinite or negative residual becomes null with NATIVE_OPERATION_INVALID_UNATTRIBUTED_RESIDUAL, never clamped.

exact_row_selection.arrays: Both arrays are null if observer initialization failed; otherwise both arrays keep their exact order, including all uncalled rows.
exact_row_selection.exclusive_seconds: Accumulated measured exclusive seconds only if calls>0, observer.error is null and complete is true; otherwise null. A failed but fully timed operation can carry finite partial seconds. An external setup/finish/clock observation_error does not erase otherwise recorded rows.
exact_row_selection.status: NOT_OBSERVED if calls==0; otherwise PARTIAL if observer.error is nonnull or failed_calls is nonzero or complete is false; otherwise OBSERVED_COMPLETE.

operation.failure: FAILED records the original authenticate BaseException type and observed partial operation counters. OBSERVER_ERROR has no original native failure but the observer failed. Diagnostic statuses, missing bins and residuals never become mathematical admission gates. Raw stderr and original native exit remain authoritative inputs to the driver.

nonoverlap.algorithm: A local observer stack records actual operation entry/exit monotonic times. Each frame accumulates nested elapsed time; only elapsed minus completed nested elapsed is charged to its category. A measured first parse or explicit I/O frame is an excluded category. The same nested duration is never charged to both a parent and child bin.
nonoverlap.io: Actual safe_file(...).read_bytes operations in the already editable read_json and reused_parent_reduction helpers are wrapped as explicit-json-io. File/path I/O and direct read_bytes calls elsewhere are outside measured operation bins and remain unattributed. No proxy Path, builtin monkeypatch, tracing/profile hook or extra I/O is used.
nonoverlap.no_clamping: Negative/nonfinite exclusive time or an inconsistent stack becomes an observation error with nullable timings. It is never clamped to a mathematical PASS or assigned to seal.
nonoverlap.no_outer_addition: Never add these exclusive bins to their inclusive authenticate/native-metadata interval or to old overlapping ordered/parser windows.

canonical.nested: All canonical calls reached inside the authenticate interval are counted, including parser canonical validation and seal reconstruction. Nested measured operations are removed from this category's exclusive time. No new canonical call is made for measurement.
canonical.primitive: The original complete canonical function, including json.dumps with the original options, final LF and ASCII encoding. A wrapper returns the exact bytes object from the original function. Its original body is retained under an internal name; the public callable is a nonrecursive wrapper.

repeated-loads.cache: The retained second raw reduction read does not call loads, so it cannot become either a first or repeated parse. A first failing parser attempt is still the first invocation; no successful result is invented.
repeated-loads.context: read_json supplies the actual path only for the duration of its original json_bytes call and restores it in finally. The context covers all roots read inside this authenticate interval, not only the newest root. Unattributed direct json_bytes calls use the excluded unattributed-loads bin. Different roles start new observation contexts.
repeated-loads.primitive: The original json.loads(raw.decode('ascii')) in json_bytes, invoked exactly once through a nonrecursive operation wrapper. ASCII decoding is explicitly included; canonical validation after loads is separately timed.
repeated-loads.unit: Attempt ordinal within one authenticate interval, keyed by the actual role, supplied absolute root Path and relative document name. The first actual loads invocation for that path is first-loads; later actual loads invocations are repeated-loads. No extra read, hash or parsing is performed to establish identity.

seal-and-typed-loop.limits: This category does not mean every remaining native loop, all generic seal operations, or the full native-metadata residual. Any unrelated loop stays unattributed. A failure inside an open typecheck window records only the measured partial interval.
seal-and-typed-loop.loop: Only the existing ordered-reduction typecheck window: after the successful batch_saved_full_ordered_reduction_ancestry require has started the existing observer's typecheck, until before the next same-candidate manifest read. These original metadata element loops contain no file read. The original require, OrderedReductionObserver and mathematical reader bodies stay raw; notifications are attached to their already allowed observer dispatch boundary.
seal-and-typed-loop.seal: The original check_seal function is invoked once through a wrapper. Its nested canonical and sha intervals are attributed to those categories, leaving only its exclusive checks and object/seal bookkeeping.

sha256.primitive: The original complete sha helper, hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), with the same raw object and one digest operation. It is returned unchanged through a nonrecursive wrapper.
sha256.scope: Actual sha helper invocations in the native interval. Direct hashing outside this helper is not silently covered. There is no repeated-input digest for observer bookkeeping.

operation.order: For each actual native batch role: supporting parent-authentication event, then operation event, then the retained ordered-reductions event, parser-bytes event and ordinary native-metadata timing. The normal full-path P order would contain74 events across these families; this is a source-derived conditional order, not a required mathematical outcome.
operation.ordinal: ordinary integer 0..7 paired to role index

row_types.exclusive_seconds: finite nonnegative number excluding bool, or null
row_types.name: exact category name at the registered array index

operation.scalar_types: Counters are ordinary nonnegative integers, never bool. Times are finite nonnegative int/float excluding bool, or null. Timestamp/type labels are strings or null according to observation availability. Initialization failure leaves interval arrays null. coverage explicitly distinguishes full observed interval, partial failed interval and observer error.

statuses.absence: An uncalled operation has calls0 and exclusive_seconds null with NOT_OBSERVED. Missing events and observer initialization failures are missing observations, never zero time.

types.excluded_intervals: null or exact ordered three-row array
types.inclusive_seconds: finite nonnegative number excluding bool, or null
types.monotonic_finished_seconds: finite nonnegative number excluding bool, or null
types.monotonic_started_seconds: finite nonnegative number excluding bool, or null
types.operation_intervals: null or exact ordered four-row array
types.ordinal: ordinary integer 0..7 paired to role index
types.unattributed_seconds: finite nonnegative number excluding bool, or null

order_scope: Conditional full normal run path only. Failed authentication can emit failed/partial auxiliary records before its ordinary successful native event would exist. Missing logger output, early stop, no observations, observer errors and read-only completed resume remain represented by actual stderr/exit/branch; do not fabricate the 74 rows or upgrade them to mathematical PASS.

finish_inputs.nullable: target_parents null if constructing observer metadata failed; completed_parent_roles all23 only if original call returned, otherwise null. Failure coverage PARTIAL_RANGE_UNAVAILABLE; successful coverage ALL_TARGET_PARENTS_COMPLETED.
finish_inputs.ordinal: ordinary integer call ordinal, normally 0 for either single invocation branch
finish_inputs.scope: One original finish_inputs call plus the registered current table finish check and eight registered public-metadata raw after pins. The old full inventory/portable/host acceptance boundary is preserved; the added eight-file check is inside the same inclusive interval. Failure invents no completed-parent prefix.

ordered.nullable: All parsed counters are null if no parse returned; typechecked counters/time are null if no typecheck closed. Unknown parsed list lengths keep element count null. uncompleted_read_parses is an ordinary nonnegative integer. The pending document and original failure/observer error remain nullable.
ordered.reuse: The retained second raw reduction recheck does not enter read_json and is not a repeated parser attempt. No per-row parsed object crosses the same role/path/row reuse boundary.
ordered.scope: Original successful reduction read_json through optional generic seal; actual successful length require opens the original typecheck window, next same-candidate manifest read closes it. Inclusive first-to-last span differs from sums of read/parse and typecheck subintervals.

ordinary.nullable: files/file_bytes are populated for inventory; rows/records for restore. Other count fields remain null. This schema has no status field and is emitted only after successful caller completion.

parser.aggregation: Read attempts and bytes include repeated parses; successful/failed bytes are separate. uncompleted_reads=read_calls-successful_parses-failed_parses-failed_reads. Do not combine this inclusive read/parse window additively with native or new operation intervals.
parser.nullable: Per-kind object is null until that kind has an actual target read; totals null until any observed kind. Successful read/parse time null if successful_parses is zero. Missing events stay missing.
parser.scope: Same raw handed to original parser. Target match is output/candidates/[0-9]{6}/reduction/(reduction[.]json|physical-literal[.]json). Unique counts use first raw parse attempt, not first successful parse; failed reads before raw do not count as parse attempts. Reused second raw read remains outside this observer.

stats_types.read_parse_elapsed_seconds: finite nonnegative number excluding bool or null
